data.name: Gensokyo Survivors: Return of the Scarlet Devil
data.detailed_description:
🎮Playable Demo Coming Soon!　

✨A fast-paced bullet heaven set in Gensokyo, packed with intense action and satisfying short play sessions.

　　Blast through relentless enemy hordes and deadly bullet hell attacks!

　　Choose your skills, craft unique builds, and carve your own path to victory.

◆Game Features◆

　・Fast-paced survivor-like action playable in 5-10 minutes.

　・Touhou Favorites Assemble at the Scarlet Devil Mansion!

　・Infinite Replayability with Dynamic Builds

　・Thrilling High-Density Action: Mow Down Endless Hordes!

　・Dual Modes: Story-Driven or Pure Action.

◆About the Game◆

Short bursts of pure, action-packed combat.

Survive relentless enemy hordes and bullet hell while choosing skills and abilities to create your own build.

Each character features unique ultimate skills and evasion moves, completely transforming your playstyle.

Powerful bosses await you at the end of each stage. Defeat them to unlock them as new playable allies!

◆Two Gameplay Modes◆

　・Character Mode: Fight using unique, character-specific skills and bullet hell.

　・Custom Mode: Mix and match all skills freely to create your ultimate build.

Different combat strategies unfold in each stage

*This game supports both story-focused progression and action-focused gameplay.

Progressing through either mode unlocks new features, allowing you to advance through the game your own way.

◆Game Highlights◆

A challenging, (highly) rewarding survivor-style action game.

Fight through massive enemy hordes, dodge relentless bullet hell attacks, and take on powerful enemies with devastating abilities.

Whether you win with pure skill or dominate with powerful builds, the choice is yours.

◆Replayability◆

Short runs make it easy to dive in anytime.

“I want to create an even better build next time.”

Chasing that perfect run creates an addictive gameplay loop that keeps pulling you back in.

◆Story◆

Gensokyo, a land that accepts all things.

But one day, an incident occurs: youkai and fairies across the land begin to run amok.

The cause? "Fragments of Memory."

Anyone who touches them falls under the influence of the memories within and loses control.

Uncover the truth behind the incident and save Gensokyo.
